honing_confound: Asura's Path: Asura State provides +6% damage to self and party (identity skill). This party buff scales with identity activation frequency; base damage from fist skills scales with gear honing. Entropy build (Crit/Swiftness) scales with T4 gear stats.

delivery.evidence: Breaker is a brawler class — massive fist attacks, punch combos. Falling Flower (Z in Kingfist identity) is the signature skill. Asura's Path uses burst fist combos with on-cast identity gauge generation.

footprint.evidence: Brawler-style close-range impacts. Large fist attacks hit in small-radius impacts at melee. Not wide AoE — concentrated burst.

geo_text: Asura's Path Breaker is a fast non-stop brawler. Identity gauge fills on cast (not on-hit, distinguishing it from other identities). At 100% gauge: Asura State (Z) activates for 10 seconds — party +6% damage + enhanced basic attacks + enhanced damage from crit rate. The rhythm: attack continuously, fill gauge passively, enter Asura State for burst/buff window.

control.evidence: Brawler archetype — heavy Stagger output from fist strikes. Asura State may enhance stagger. No primary CC identity but stagger is significant.

defense.evidence: Brawler moderate armor profile. Mobility from quick dashes between strike combos.

economy.resource_verbatim: Fighting Spirit / Asura Energy (Identity Gauge) — fills on CAST not on-hit
economy.builder_source: All skill CASTS fill Asura Energy (on-cast, not on-hit). Fast casting fills gauge quickly. No dedicated builder category — everything fills the gauge.
economy.plain_text: ON-CAST ECONOMY: Asura Energy fills by CASTING skills (regardless of whether they hit). This means the Breaker can build gauge even when the boss is invulnerable or repositioning. At 100%: Z key → Asura State (10s): Fighting Spirit → Asura Destruction; self + party +6% damage; basic attacks enhanced; damage scales with crit rate. The economy is forgiving (on-cast not on-hit) and the burst window is short (10s).

element.evidence: Breaker is a brawler — Physical damage from fist strikes. Some skills may have arcane/void theming.

movement.evidence: 'Non-stop action build' per official description. Fast combo movement between strikes. High attack speed (Swiftness secondary stat for Asura's Path).

attr.evidence: All melee brawler. Point-blank fist combat.

range.evidence: Fist strikes at arm's reach. No ranged output.

tempo.evidence: Asura's Path has a 10-second Asura State window (burst phase). But on-cast economy makes gauge fill fast → frequent burst windows → almost sustained feel. Closer to fast-cycling burst than traditional single-burst.

amp.evidence: Directly sourced from search results: 'party members +6%' and 'damage increases based on Crit Rate' in Asura State.

mechanics_notes: 1) PARTY SUPPORT RIDER: Asura State provides +6% damage to the entire party — unusual for a DPS-primary MA identity. This makes Asura's Path Breaker slightly party-support-adjacent (similar to Shining Knight Valkyrie's synergy debuff). Not a support class but has a meaningful raid contribution beyond personal damage. 2) ON-CAST ECONOMY is the key innovation: most LA meter fills 'on-hit' — Breaker's on-cast means never losing meter to boss invulnerability/dodge phases. This is a boss-fight-friendly design that reduces the frustration of mobility checks. 3) The Kingfist identity (Falling Flower Z skill) contrasts by having a specific identity skill as the burst tool rather than a state transformation. Asura's Path = state burst; Kingfist = skill burst. 4) BREAKER RELEASED JUNE 2024: post-training class. Mechanics verified from official playlostark.com breakdown and community guides (nexus-guide). Post-cutoff flag: low on risk since class received extensive community documentation quickly.
stabilization_patch: Breaker stabilized quickly post-June 2024 release; Asura's Path was the dominant identity in initial meta.

footprint.evidence: Falling Flower is a single powerful strike — focused impact rather than wide AoE. Shock skills during Kingfist State hit in concentrated small-radius impacts.

Primary damage: Shock skills during Kingfist State (Specialization boosts these). The identity is 'save identity for FALLING FLOWER moment.'

amp.evidence: Directly sourced from search results: 'Kingfist State increases from 10s to 15s and Attack Speed buff increases from +10% to +20%. Specialization directly increases Shock skill damage during Kingfist State.'

commitment.evidence: Falling Flower (the identity skill) is described as 'strongest and most imposing' — implies significant charge/wind-up animation. The identity moment has high commitment.

mechanics_notes: 1) Kingfist's FALLING FLOWER moment is a 'signature attack' identity — the entire build exists to reach the moment where you can fire Falling Flower for maximum damage. This is similar to Arcanist Empress's Grace's 4-stack detonation as the identity moment. 2) Kingfist vs Asura's Path: Asura's Path is a STATE that enhances all output for 10s; Kingfist is a STATE that grants access to ONE specific skill (Falling Flower) while enhancing overall output for 15s. Kingfist is more 'single focal point' while Asura's Path is more 'global enhancement.' 3) Specialization as primary stat for Kingfist means the gear optimization is SIMPLER (one stat priority) vs Asura's Path's Crit/Swiftness split. This may make Kingfist more accessible for gear planning. 4) The search result notes 'Specialization: directly increases the damage of your Shock skills during Kingfist State as well as your meter generation.' This reveals the Specialization → meter generation link — higher Specialization = faster gauge fill = more frequent Kingfist State. A single stat affects BOTH burst frequency and burst power simultaneously.
stabilization_patch: Kingfist was the alternative to Asura's Path at launch; relative meta position has fluctuated with balance patches.
